inlineContent.text: YBVRAppleSDK provides a high-level interface for streaming VR video content within custom
geometries (equirectangular sphere, fisheye, flat panel, control room, and more). It handles
configuration loading, adaptive bitrate selection, tracking, subtitles, multi-audio stream
management, server-side ad insertion, switching between content items without tearing down
the player, and moving a session between the immersive and windowed players.
This reference is published once per platform, because the visionOS-only rendering
and are compiled out of the iOS build.
Availability badges reflect whichever variant you are reading.
